project_info.theme: Romano mini shaver summer launch beach poster
project_info.color_palette: Sky blue, sand beige, royal blue, yellow, black, white

main_subject.detail: A large black Romano mini electric shaver stands inside a yellow-and-white inflatable ring on a sandy beach. The top branding shows Shopee and the Romano logo. Headline reads 'RA MAT DOC QUYEN MAY CAO RAU ROMANO MINI SACH GON LICH LAM'. Blue coupon strip reads 'GIAM DEN 30%', 'VOUCHER SHOPEEVIP LEN DEN 20%', and 'MUA LA CO QUA'. Beach balls and palm leaves frame the tropical scene.
main_subject.style: Clean tropical product-hero poster with realistic shaver render and ecommerce beach-merchandising layout

composition_elements.text: ROMANO / RA MAT DOC QUYEN MAY CAO RAU ROMANO MINI SACH GON LICH LAM / GIAM DEN 30% / VOUCHER SHOPEEVIP LEN DEN 20% / MUA LA CO QUA

Surrounding elements: Shopee and Romano logos, large headline 'RA MAT DOC QUYEN MAY CAO RAU ROMANO MINI SACH GON LICH LAM', and a blue coupon strip reading 'GIAM DEN 30%', 'VOUCHER SHOPEEVIP LEN DEN 20%', and 'MUA LA CO QUA'. Technical style: commercial product poster with photo-composite beach environment, bright tropical daylight, crisp reflections, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
